summary: Open skull data exist for Equus and probably for other equids in a CC0 Dryad dataset, but the fossil comparison skulls named in the claim (Mesohippus, Protohippus) and the Hyracotherium endpoint appear in MorphoSource only as restricted-download metapodial scans, so a skull-shape test of the interpolated series cannot yet be assembled from open repositories.
next_step: Open the Dryad zip to list specimens; if the early Tertiary genera are absent, request scans or landmark files from museum collections (e.g. the specimens behind the six Parahippus and five Mesohippus MorphoSource objects) or digitise landmarks from the literature.
